limitations: This run did not apply new patches to the canonical branch. Only the previously admitted VGO-080 focus-restore and error-association improvement is treated as an accepted metric delta versus the archived VGO-068 live baseline.

Median context reduction is reported fail-closed as 0.0. The sealed catalog ordinary-retrieval estimates are 1580-1900 tokens, but UiContextPack@1 requires the editable target source to remain raw. The current agent-supervisor.js is 2086 lines, so a pack that includes that required raw source exceeds the catalog ordinary estimate and cannot claim a 30 percent reduction. The unmet 30 percent target is disclosed rather than hidden.
Remaining catalog defects were not live-rebrowsered in this run. Candidate metrics stay at the archived VGO-068 live snapshot unless VGO-080/081 source evidence proves the specific improvement.
Primary-action hierarchy is forbidden from automatic acceptance.
